title: tc-profile-header
description:
The top of a person's or an account's page: picture, name, status and tags, other names, a line of facts, the
page's actions and an optional row of tabs.

name.description: The person's or the account's name: the page's heading

level.description: The heading's level – 1 when the header tops the page, 2 (the default) inside a layout that has its own h1

picture.description: A picture URL; without one the avatar shows the name's initials

kind.description: "person" draws a round avatar, "account" (a company, a team, a workspace) a rounded square

status.description: The status beside the name, e.g. { label: "Under review", tone: "warning" }

tags.description: More pills after the status, e.g. a priority

aliases.description: Other names the person or account goes by, as chips

aliasLabel.description: The label before the other names

meta.description: Short facts in one line, separated by dots: a role, a place, when last seen, a linked case

actions.description: The page's actions, at the right

more.description: Shows an overflow button after the actions, which fires tc-action "more"

tabs.description: Tabs for the sections below; none hides the row

selected.description: The selected tab's id; the first tab when unset. Changed by the user unless a tc-selected-change listener calls preventDefault()

tabsLabel.description: The tab row's name for screen readers

ProfilePill.description: A pill: the status beside the name, or a tag after it

ProfileMeta.description: A short fact on the meta line; `tone` puts a coloured dot before it

variant.description: "primary" for the page's main action (one at most), else "secondary" (the default)

ProfileIconName.description: The built-in action icons; or pass an icon element of your own, which is cloned

count.description: A count after the label, e.g. how many items the section holds

controls.description: The id of the panel the tab shows, for aria-controls
